questions.explanation_english: Stomata are tiny pores on the surface of leaves that allow gas exchange and water loss. Stomata play a vital role in transpiration, which is the process of water evaporation from plants. Stomatal transpiration accounts for about 80 to 90% of the total water loss from plants.
